subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second bootstrap-instruction root that overrides the agent workspace, or should per-agent bootstrap customization remain workspace-only?
rationale: This is not merely a loader correction: it changes the ownership and precedence of persistent agent instructions across a security-sensitive boundary when an existing per-agent workspace path already provides the capability.

options.title: Keep workspace-only authority
options.body: Retain the existing per-agent workspace contract and use the warning approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 to expose misplaced files.

options.title: Adopt agentDir overrides
options.body: Approve the new authority model and require complete caller propagation, compatibility documentation, focused regression coverage, and redacted real-session proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace-only authority
recommendation.body: Retain the existing per-agent workspace contract and use the warning approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 to expose misplaced files.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior repository decisions around the workspace/bootstrap contract make this the strongest available product-direction routing candidate.
